tasks.title: Implement GET /api/programs route
tasks.notes: router = APIRouter(prefix='/api/programs', tags=['programs']) (D-02). Route depends on get_current_user, get_persona_resolver (T-01), get_db. Order: (1) call program_visibility(current_user, sentinel) exactly once as a session-validity veto gate (FR-2/C-2) — a module-level constant documents the sentinel program_id is never read for scoping; (2) try/except persona_resolver.resolve(current_user.role), catching PersonaNotFoundError before PersonaResolutionError (subclass-first, mirrors rbac.py's own order) — both log WARN and raise HTTPException(403, 'Access denied'), never 500 (FR-3/C-3); (3) SELECT program_summary, WHERE program_id IN current_user.programs unless persona == 'cio' (AC-1/AC-2/AC-4 — SQLAlchemy's in_([]) on an empty programs list already yields zero rows, no special-case needed); (4) map rows to ProgramEntry{program_id, label=name, href=f'/api/overview/program-detail/{program_id}', dotStyle=dot_style_for_program(program_id)} (T-02/T-03); (5) log programs_list_returned with exactly {user_id, persona, returned_count} via extra= (FR-1/C-1); (6) ONLY on the non-cio scoping path, if returned_count < len(current_user.programs), log a separate WARN event (e.g. programs_missing_from_summary) with {user_id, expected_count, returned_count} (FR-4/C-5) — do not apply this comparison on the cio path, where returned_count is the full table size and is not meaningfully compared against current_user.programs. Module/route docstring states program_visibility's veto-gate semantics explicitly (FR-2) per Documentation requirements.
